summary: Iteration 14 full regression + verification of all 7 UI bug fixes on preview URL (mobile 390x844). Backend spot-checks: /api/v1/activity/trends?range=daily returns 13 hourly points 8AM-8PM (200); ?range=month returns 30 points with ordinal day labels like '6th','11th' (200). Podcast endpoint is /api/v1/podcasts (200) and returns SoundHelix audioUrls + tags[]. Frontend: (1) Toggle switch is a clean h-6 w-11 pill with white sliding knob, role=switch aria-checked toggles cleanly (visual confirmed via screenshot). (2) Explore SEE ALL opens AllChallengesModal with 4 items -> WorkoutDetailModal -> ActiveWorkoutModal timer counts down (20:00 -> 19:58 over 2s), Finish closes modal successfully. (3) Snacks topic modal shows exact 5 ideas (Greek Yogurt Parfait, Apple & Almond Butter, Roasted Chickpeas, Mixed Nuts, Edamame). AllCategoriesModal exposes 6 tiles including hydration + sleep; Hydration tile -> /dashboard + LogWaterModal opens. (4) Podcast Daily Pick play button starts real audio (audio.paused=false, currentTime=2.28s, src=SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3); navigating to /dashboard shows persistent MiniPlayer. Category pills filter distinct sets (new:1, now:1, popular:2, trending:1, mindset:1, sleep:2); search 'sleep' returns 2. (5) Activity chart renders SVG with visible bars for all ranges (daily=26 rects, week=14, month=60) with sparse ordinal labels (6th/11th/16th/21st/26th/31st/4th) - no overlap. (6) Quick Actions Set Reminder navigates to /profile with Reminders card scrolled into viewport. (7) AddWorkoutModal shows exactly 7 presets with correct calories (Walking 90, Outdoor Run 320, Gym Strength 250, HIIT 280, Vinyasa Yoga 140, Cycling/Spin 360, Pilates Core 160); Custom Workout accordion expands to reveal title/duration/calories inputs.

integration_issues.issue: Timer appears to continue ticking briefly after pause click in automated test (t3=19:57, t4=19:56 across 1.5s). May be a race with click event under Playwright force=true rather than a real regression - please spot check manually.

critical_code_review_comments: Podcast route is mounted at /api/v1/podcasts (not /wellness/podcasts). Consider aligning path with the frontend feature module namespace for consistency, or add an alias.

AddWorkoutModal onboarding tooltip ('Log your meals... GOT IT') visually overlaps the custom-workout form inputs on 390px viewport (see screenshot). Consider suppressing tooltips while a modal is open.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 UI fixes for iteration 14 are verified working on preview URL. Backend podcasts route is /api/v1/podcasts. Activity trends supports daily|week|month with ordinal labels for month. Toggle component is uniform across settings + reminders. MiniPlayer only appears on non-podcast screens while audio plays. If retesting pause functionality, consider using page.click() without force=true or add page.wait_for_timeout(150) between click and read.
